entry_rule: At least one observed supporting graph witness for disease, target or pathway relevance. Association alone never proves benefit.
hard_rule: Carry forward the published first-pass eligibility screen. At targeted review veto a documented contraindication whose prerequisites the chart meets, a label-directed avoid/contraindicated combination with an actual medication, a named strong/moderate CYP1A2 inhibitor under the prior riluzole screen, or a labeled serious respiratory-depression risk explicitly applicable to underlying respiratory impairment. Require a matching chart fact and a primary source. Do not infer contraindications from class similarity, an interaction edge, or missing labs.
soft_rule: Subtract one fixed penalty for a sourced clinically consequential caution applicable to the chart that falls below the veto threshold. Do not stack penalties for multiple warnings. Negative efficacy evidence is reported independently.
